display.purpose: Panel titles. Uppercase, one per panel.

label.purpose: Field labels and button text. Sans-medium.

dos: Do set page ground + ink once on ShellWrapper and layer everything with color-mix veils.
Do keep touch targets >=44px and gaps on the 4px scale (8/12/16/24).
Do render numbers in mono 14px; labels in sans-medium.
Do apply the Three-Glow steps (rest subtle -> hover 8% -> press 14% + scale 0.98).
donts: Don't add backdrop-filter: blur() to new surfaces.
Don't use raw hex grays — derive borders/shadows from the active tint.
Don't invent a new radius or shadow tier.
Don't put body copy in sans or labels in mono.
Don't build a one-off page layout — reuse ExperimentShell + ControlPanel + Stage.
keyCharacteristics: Instrument bench framing a stage: docked 320px control panel + fluid canvas stage.
Warm paper / charcoal page grounds with 8 hardware-named tints as translucent veils.
Chunky, pressable controls with three-step neon intensity.
Mono for values, sans for labels; uppercase micro-headings.
Flat by default; depth signals affordance.
narrative.overview: A quiet lab bench for loud experiments. The chrome is small, dense and instrument-like — uppercase micro-headings, mono readouts, 44px touch targets — so WebGL canvases, Voronoi toys, mosaics and molecule viewers can be wild, colorful and tactile at full 60 FPS. Personality comes from the artifacts, not the furniture. Curious, technical yet playful, understated craft. No marketing hyperbole, no SaaS tropes. The system recedes; the experiment leads.

rules.body: A surface sets one tint color; background uses it at 12%, border at 38%, strong border at 72%.
rules.name: The One-Variable Tint Rule

rules.body: No backdrop-filter: blur() on new surfaces; use flat veils + tinted shadow instead.
rules.name: The No-Blur Rule

rules.body: Neon intensity: subtle veil at rest, stronger wash on hover (8%), strongest on press/active (14% + scale 0.98).
rules.name: The Three-Glow Rule

rules.body: Headings levels 1-3 are always uppercase with 0.02em tracking.
rules.name: The Uppercase Bench Rule

rules.body: Any number the user reads or edits is mono.
rules.name: The Mono-Truth Rule

rules.body: Raised = pressable or floating. Sunken = editable. Flat = informational.
rules.name: The Affordance Depth Rule
